answer_1.quote: We convert the existing event type ontology to PYTHON class definitions. Conditioned on these definitions, we put the input sentence for event argument extraction into a docstring as the prompt for code generation. The generated code ... can be mapped to an instance graph of Transport event.
answer_1.outputs: Python code instantiating event classes that encode extracted event arguments

answer_2.quote: We consider an argument to be correctly identified when the head word span of predicted text matches that of the human-annotated text (Arg-I); we consider an argument to be correctly classified if the role of a correctly identified argument matches that of the human annotation (Arg-C). ... We report F1 scores.
